The [[Ando system/Legends|Ando system]] contained an '''asteroid field''', on the inner edge of which was a [[Unidentified Ando system planetoid|planetoid]] that contained a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] base during the [[21 BBY/Legends|second year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Almas">{{LivingForce|Decision: Almas}}</ref>
